subject: Error: micro_ncep: The datetimes specified are out of range for the Reanalysis 2 dataset.

messages.author: 4d0567a02cf38924
messages.subject: Error: micro_ncep: The datetimes specified are out of range for the Reanalysis 2 dataset.
parts:
Hello,

I'm trying to run micro_ncep with following specifications:
micro_ncep(loc=c(-119.36206,38.53405), dstart = "07/07/1977", dfinish = "08/07/1977")

I get the following error:
Error in NCEP.gather(climvar, level = "gaussian", years.minmax = c(yrs[yr],  :
  The datetimes specified are out of range for the Reanalysis 2 dataset.

The shiny app works well but when I download and run its prepared codes, I get the same error. Any help will be appreciated.

Reza

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: Error: micro_ncep: The datetimes specified are out of range for the Reanalysis 2 dataset.
parts:
Hi Reza,
Try: micro_ncep(loc=c(-119.36206,38.53405), dstart = "07/07/1977", dfinish = "08/07/1977", reanalysis = FALSE)
All the best,
Mike
